settings.securityHint: The password encrypts the vault file. A forgotten password cannot be recovered: keep it safe.
notices.autostartMoved: Starting with the system is in «This device» settings
tour.lessonsLink: Workflow lessons are in the Workflows section
dashboard.catalog.title: Widget catalog
dashboard.catalog.description: Pick what to add to the dashboard. The widget takes the first free spot.
dashboard.catalog.allPlaced: Every widget is already on the dashboard.
dashboard.emptyGrid: The dashboard is empty — add widgets with «+».
dashboard.widgetHint.onboarding: First set-up steps: wallets, debts, salary.
dashboard.widgetHint.dailyBudget: How much you can spend today.
dashboard.widgetHint.monthSummary: Income, spending and savings this month.
dashboard.widgetHint.miniCalendar: The month with spending per day.
dashboard.widgetHint.budgets: Limits and how much is used.
dashboard.widgetHint.exchangeBalances: Exchange balances next to the ledger; when they still disagree after every operation, the live balance is set.
dashboard.widgetHint.bybitSync: Operations loaded from the exchange: confirm one by one or all, sync now.
tour.dashboard.grid.title: The dashboard is your grid
tour.dashboard.grid.body: Drag a widget by its header, resize it by the bottom-right corner. Gaps fill themselves. «Hide header» pins a widget.
tour.dashboard.quickAdd.title: Record a transaction
tour.dashboard.quickAdd.body: Income, spending, a transfer or an exchange — from any screen, with the header button or a key combination.
tour.dashboard.add.title: Add a widget
tour.dashboard.add.body: The «Widgets» button opens the catalog with a description and a live preview of each widget.
tour.dashboard.wallets.title: Wallets by kind
tour.dashboard.wallets.body: Cash is there from the start. Banks, crypto, exchanges, property and loans are added here or with «+» on their group.
tour.dashboard.palette.title: Go to
tour.dashboard.palette.body: Search screens, wallets and actions right in the header. Ctrl+K puts the cursor here from anywhere, Enter opens, Esc closes.
tour.dashboard.settings.title: Settings
tour.dashboard.settings.body: Theme, language, currency, categories and budget — in one window with sections on the left.
tour.dashboard.contextMenu.title: Help is always near
tour.dashboard.contextMenu.body: «?» shows the tour of the current screen. Right-click any block for quick actions on it.
tour.wallet.settings.title: Wallet settings
tour.wallet.settings.body: What the money is for, sub-accounts and envelopes, automations and the exchange connection — here.
tour.wallet.utilityReminders.title: Utility reminders
tour.wallet.utilityReminders.body: Set the pay day — each month you get «Pay the utilities» and «Send the readings» three days earlier.
tour.wallet.views.title: Exchange sections
tour.wallet.views.body: Balance overview, a chart terminal and trade import. The terminal remembers everything in this exchange.
tour.wallet.terminal.title: Terminal
tour.wallet.terminal.body: Coins on the left; drawings and timeframe are saved in the exchange — every exchange has its own terminal.
tour.walletSettings.purpose.title: What the money is for
tour.walletSettings.purpose.body: Decides whether spending counts in the daily budget. A deposit is savings, an exchange is investment, a tax account is transit.
tour.walletSettings.envelopes.title: Envelopes
tour.walletSettings.envelopes.body: Put part of the balance aside for a purpose without moving money. An envelope can back a goal.
tour.walletSettings.presets.title: Ready-made automations
tour.walletSettings.presets.body: Templates for this kind of wallet: salary, loan payment, DCA. Only the amount and date are left to fill in.
tour.walletSettings.importSetup.title: Setting up the import
tour.walletSettings.importSetup.body: After the key, choose what to take from the exchange and where to book it: trades, transfers, Earn, accounts, coins.
tour.walletSettings.importRoutes.title: Where each exchange account goes
tour.walletSettings.importRoutes.body: Funding, Unified and Earn: into their own sub-account, a chosen account, or nowhere.
tour.directory.create.title: New contact
tour.directory.create.body: Type a name and press Enter — the rest is filled in right in the card.
tour.directory.editor.title: A card without dialogs
tour.directory.editor.body: Click a field and edit — it saves itself. Just paste a requisite: its kind and network are detected.
tour.directory.debts.title: Debts
tour.directory.debts.body: The debt is what the operations add up to. The buttons open a transfer of the right kind; set a due date and a note below.
tour.directory.transactions.title: Transactions with a contact
tour.directory.transactions.body: Opens the transaction list filtered to this contact.
ui.loadErrorHint: Make sure the vault is unlocked, then press Retry.
ui.noData: No data for the selected period
ui.noDataHint: Change the period or the filters above.
contacts.groupHint: E.g. «Family», «Work», «P2P». Without one the contact is listed under its kind.
tx.deleteConfirmHint: It disappears from the history and balances are recalculated. This cannot be undone.
tx.tradeOnUnified: The trade is booked on «{name}»: spot and futures live on the Unified Trading account.
storeWizard.openingHint: What is already there. Booked as one «Opening balance» operation — neither income nor spending.
storeWizard.openingInvalid: Enter a positive amount and an asset
storeWizard.bybitKeyHint: Optional: a read-only Bybit key. With it the needed sub-accounts appear right away: Unified Trading and the ones Bybit holds coins in. You can add the key later in the exchange settings too.
storeWizard.cardHint: A card is a bank account. The opening balance goes on it; more cards and accounts in this bank can be opened later with «New sub-account».
adjustment.title: Match reality
adjustment.hint: Enter what the account really holds. The difference is booked as a correction: it is neither income nor spending and stays out of budgets and reports. Change the operations before this date later, and the difference is recalculated on its own — the balance stays what you entered.
adjustment.dateHint: Empty means now. A past date compares with the ledger of that moment.
adjustment.empty: Nothing on this account yet. Add an asset below if it is really there.
adjustment.addAsset: An asset the ledger does not know
adjustment.nothing: Enter the actual balance of at least one asset that differs from the ledger.
adjustment.submit: Book the correction | Book the correction ({count}) | Book the correction ({count})
tour.wallet.adjust.title: Match reality
tour.wallet.adjust.body: When the app's balance drifts from the bank or the wallet, enter the real balance: the difference is booked as a correction, not as income or spending.
storeChange.openHint: Turn a bank into a crypto wallet, move an account into another wallet of any kind, make a sub-account a wallet of its own, or merge two accounts. Operations are kept.
storeChange.title: Change kind or move: {name}
storeChange.hint: See what changes first. A .bak copy of the vault is kept before it is applied.
storeChange.nothing: Nothing to change here: the cash wallet stays what it is.
storeChange.actionHint.change_kind: Sub-accounts the new kind can hold move along (a card becomes a token account and so on). The others are split off as archived wallets of the old kind, their operations intact.
storeChange.actionHint.move_to: The account becomes a sub-account of the wallet you pick, even of another kind: its type is matched. A wallet without sub-accounts that holds one asset can be moved in too.
storeChange.actionHint.detach: The sub-account becomes a wallet of its own, of the same kind, with all its operations.
storeChange.actionHint.merge_into: Every operation of this account moves to the one you pick, and this account goes. Transfers between the two would land on one account: they show as conflicts.
storeChange.conflicts: Would not fit after the change: {count}. Fix or delete them, then try again.
storeChange.backupHint: The previous vault is kept next to it as .bak
tour.directory.groups.title: Contact groups
tour.directory.groups.body: The list is split into groups. Set one in the contact's «Group» field; without it the contact goes under its kind: people, companies, exchangers.
reminder.repeatHint: Marking it done moves it to the next date. The day is kept: the 31st becomes a short month's last day.
reminder.autoEditHint: This is an automatic reminder: after an edit its time stays yours and the sync leaves it alone.
reminder.doneRepeatHint: Done: move it to the next date
reminder.autoHint: Made from the data: a loan, rent, utilities, a deposit, a debt, a goal or a tax. It moves when the day changes and closes the month once the payment is booked. Delete it, and it does not come back.
simulation.title: Automations, tried out
simulation.hint: The automations run day by day on a copy of the vault, as the scheduler would run them. Nothing is written, so try anything.
simulation.nothing: The automations do nothing in this time.
tour.planningAutomations.simulate.title: Try without risk
tour.planningAutomations.simulate.body: «Try it out» runs the automations ahead on a copy of the vault: what would be created, where money would run short and what the balances would be. Nothing is written.
tour.planningAutomations.unconfirmed.bod: A salary that differs is booked approximately, at the average of the latest 3. Put in what came and the next estimate gets closer.
tour.planningAutomations.confirmAmount.b: Type the real amount: the operation is corrected and the «approximate» mark goes.
tour.planningAutomations.openWorkflow.bo: Open it in the workflow editor to see how it works and run an emulation.
tour.planningReminders.filter.title: Yours and automatic
tour.planningReminders.filter.body: The app reminds you of loan, rent and utility payments, deposits ending, debts, goals and taxes by itself: those are «Auto». Edit or stop one in the «More» menu; switch whole kinds on and off in Settings → Notifications.
notices.title: Notifications
notices.hint: Everything the app told you: reminders, alerts, payments, money running short. Click one to go there.
notices.emptyHint: Reminders, payment due dates, fired alerts and workflow questions show up here. What to send is chosen in the notification settings.
notices.systemHint: Show notices outside the app window too. Inside the app they always come.
notices.hideDetails: Hide details while the vault is locked
notices.hideDetailsHint: «Loan payment» without the name and the sum, for when others may see the screen.
notices.defaultTimeHint: When reminders of payments, due dates and taxes come.
notices.catHint.utilities: The utilities pay day and the readings before it
notices.catHint.deposit: A deposit ending, the ПДС contribution
notices.catHint.goal: Saving for a goal and its deadline
notices.catHint.tax: Property tax and tax on deposit interest, when there is a reason
notices.catHint.security: The vault was handed to another device
notices.catHint.shortfall: A planned payment the balance will not cover
notices.catHint.budget: A limit nearly used up or exceeded
notices.catHint.automation: Created or rejected by an automation
notices.lockedKeyring: Reminders, due dates and price alerts keep coming with the vault closed, even after a restart: a 60-day schedule is kept encrypted. When you open the vault, everything shown goes into the log, without repeats.
notices.lockedMemory: While the app runs, notices come with the vault closed too. After a restart, only once you open it: the system could not keep the schedule safely.
notices.autostartHint: The app starts hidden in the tray, so reminders come after a reboot too.
tx.p2p.hint: You send from your account to a person (a P2P seller, an exchanger), they send to your account in another currency.
tx.toCurrencyHint: Not a crypto account: the money arrives in its currency, {code}.
tx.split.linkedHint: All rows are saved as linked operations, one chain.
tx.split.receiveHint: If the money lands on several accounts, add rows: each has its account and amount.
tx.split.receivedTotal: Receiving in total: {total}. What you give is split between the accounts in proportion.
tx.split.topupHint: The top-up is split between the accounts, each with its amount.
tx.missing.title: To save, fill in
tx.missing.toAmount: how much you receive (or the rate)
tx.missing.extra: the accounts and amounts in the «Where I receive» rows
tour.dashboard.bell.title: Notifications
tour.dashboard.bell.body: The bell keeps everything the app told you: reminders, payments, alerts, money running short. Choose what to get in Settings → Notifications.
tour.stores.list.title: All wallets
tour.stores.list.body: Each card is a wallet with its sub-accounts and balance. Click one to open its operations.
tour.stores.create.title: New wallet
tour.stores.create.body: A bank comes with its card right away, an exchange with its Bybit sub-accounts when you give a key.
tour.wallet.operation.title: Record a transaction
tour.wallet.operation.body: Top up, pay, transfer, exchange: the asset comes from the account by itself, and the form says what is missing.
tour.walletSettings.change.title: Change kind or move
tour.walletSettings.change.body: In the danger zone: turn a bank into a crypto wallet, move an account into another wallet or merge accounts. You see what changes first.
tour.transactions.tabs.title: Transaction views
tour.transactions.tabs.body: The transaction list, the spending calendar, contacts and debts.
tour.transactions.filter.title: Filter
tour.transactions.filter.body: Wallet, kind, contact, dates and search, by card number and hash too.
tour.transactions.list.title: Transactions
tour.transactions.list.body: Click a transaction for its details and to link it with others; the pencil edits, the bin deletes.
tour.transactionsLosses.content.title: Losses and chains
tour.transactionsLosses.content.body: Linked operations (a P2P exchange, a move through an exchange) form one chain: here is what went to fees and the rate.
tour.transactionsCalendar.content.title: Spending calendar
tour.transactionsCalendar.content.body: What was spent each day of the month and what is planned next.
tour.analytics.tabs.title: Reports
tour.analytics.tabs.body: The overview answers the main questions; three sections go deeper: income and spending, what you have, and how investments do.
tour.analytics.filter.title: Period and wallets
tour.analytics.filter.body: Set the dates, wallets and currency of the report: every chart follows.
tour.analytics.export.title: Export
tour.analytics.export.body: Save the report to a file to open in a spreadsheet.
tour.analytics.insights.title: In plain words
tour.analytics.insights.body: What the numbers mean: spent more or less, where the money went, whether savings grew.
tour.analytics.overviewInsights.title: Facts in words
tour.analytics.overviewInsights.body: Under the figures: what changed and why — spending up, the top category, the best month.
tour.analytics.overview.title: The month at a glance
tour.analytics.overview.body: Four cards with a takeaway each. «Details» opens the report with the same filter.
tour.analytics.flowView.title: Three views
tour.analytics.flowView.body: By month shows income and spending, Year what you kept, Categories where the money goes.
tour.analytics.flow.title: Income and spending
tour.analytics.flow.body: Hover a column name to see what it holds. The month-by-month table is under the chart.
tour.analytics.realTerms.title: In today's money
tour.analytics.realTerms.body: Restates past months by inflation, so you see whether buying power grows.
tour.analytics.wealth.title: What I have
tour.analytics.wealth.body: Everything you have minus debts, and how each wallet changed.
tour.analytics.investments.title: Investments
tour.analytics.investments.body: What the portfolio is made of, the trading result and what fees and conversions cost.
tour.analytics.saldo.title: Day-by-day balance
tour.analytics.saldo.body: What is left of the month after each day: the reserve (income minus planned mandatory and savings) minus everyday spending. Days ahead are a forecast; a date in the table or a point on a chart opens that day's transactions.
tour.analytics.saldoPool.title: Where the balance comes from
tour.analytics.saldoPool.body: Income minus planned mandatory and savings is the reserve; everyday spending draws it down. The biggest days open their transactions: give rent or a one-off a mandatory category and it stops eating the balance.
tour.planning.tabs.title: Planning
tour.planning.tabs.body: Automations, limits, goals, reminders and price alerts: everything that looks ahead.
tour.planningAutomations.content.title: Automations
tour.planningAutomations.content.body: Operations on a schedule. They are made on the wallet page; here is the overview and history, on the right what is planned.
tour.planningBudgets.content.title: Limits
tour.planningBudgets.content.body: A limit per day, week or month, on everything, a category or a wallet. When it is nearly used up, you get a notice.
tour.planningGoals.content.title: Goals
tour.planningGoals.content.body: A goal is a sum by a date on the wallets you choose. Say how much to put aside a month and an automatic reminder appears.
tour.planningReminders.content.title: Reminders
tour.planningReminders.content.body: With a date, a time and a repeat. They arrive as notices, even with the vault locked; «done» on a repeating one moves it on.
tour.planningAlerts.content.title: Price alerts
tour.planningAlerts.content.body: A price threshold of an asset in any currency: you are told when the price crosses it.
tour.centerHint: Screen tours: {done} of {total} done. Press ▶ to go through one again.
whatsNew.salary.title: A salary that differs
whatsNew.salary.varies: An automation can take an amount that differs every time: on payday the average of the latest 3 is booked, and you put in what came later.
whatsNew.salary.workday: A date on a day off or a holiday moves to a working day: earlier, the way salaries are paid, or later.
whatsNew.salary.confirm: «Put in the amount» is in the automation’s history, in «Upcoming» and in the payday notice.
whatsNew.salary.workflows: Automations run as workflows now: open one in the editor to see how it works.
whatsNew.rename.title: New name: Multi Wallet Tracker
whatsNew.rename.name: TradeApp is now Multi Wallet Tracker (MWT). Your vault, settings, recent files and reminders moved over by themselves — nothing to do.
whatsNew.rename.command: The program now starts as multi-wallet-tracker. If you bound «+ Operation» to a key in Hyprland/Sway, replace trade-app with multi-wallet-tracker there (the ready line is in Settings → General → Quick add).
whatsNew.title: What's new
whatsNew.hint: What changed in the app and where to see it.
whatsNew.round13.title: A big update
whatsNew.round13.vault: The vault was moved to a new format version: data is carried over, the previous file sits next to it as .v1.bak. From now on new fields will not break older files.
whatsNew.round13.adjustment: «Match reality»: enter what the account really holds — the difference is booked as a correction, neither income nor spending. Changing the history before a correction recalculates it on its own.
whatsNew.round13.p2p: Exchange directly or through P2P; what you receive can land on several of your accounts, each with its amount, as one linked chain.
whatsNew.round13.picker: A new account picker: search, the name on top and the details under it, no duplicates. The asset comes from the account, and the form says what is missing.
whatsNew.round13.assetCurrencies: The asset field now offers regular currencies — USD, RUB, EUR with their names — apart from crypto. Fees and losses in them are counted in full at the FX rate. In the recipient picker a contact’s accounts sit indented under it.
whatsNew.round13.notifications: Notices everywhere: a bell with history, money running short, limits, and reminders come even with the vault locked.
whatsNew.round13.autoReminders: Automatic reminders of loan, rent and utility payments, deposits ending, debts, goals and taxes.
whatsNew.round13.reminders: Reminders get a time, a repeat and a snooze.
whatsNew.round13.simulation: «Try it out» for automations: a run ahead on a copy of the vault, nothing written.
whatsNew.round13.storeChange: Change a wallet's kind, move, split off and merge accounts — in the danger zone.
whatsNew.round13.bank: A bank comes with its card: a card is the account.
whatsNew.round13.exchange: Exchange trading lives on the Unified Trading account; Bybit sub-accounts are made from the key.
whatsNew.round13.utilities: Meter readings are dated from a calendar, and «Record expense» and the monthly bill price the latest unpaid readings themselves.
validation.summary: Check the marked fields — the form cannot be saved without them
validation.keyPair: Both the key and the secret are needed — or leave both empty
validation.splitRows: Give each row an account and an amount — or remove the empty row
validation.category: Pick a category — or add a rule in Settings that fills it in
validation.billLines: Tick at least one line with an amount
validation.billAmounts: Every ticked line needs an amount above zero
validation.rates: Every rate needs a date and a percentage of zero or more
validation.duplicateAsset: This asset is already in the list above
validation.confirmName: Type the name «{name}» exactly as it is written
validation.pair: Write a pair like BTCUSDT or BTC/USDT
validation.pickOperations: Tick at least one operation to link
validation.duplicateCurrency: This currency is already in the list
flows.continueNoStore: The operation has no account of yours — there is nothing to continue the chain from
contacts.transferArchived: The contact is archived — restore it to record a transfer
contacts.transferNoStore: Create a wallet first — the transfer is recorded from it
quickAdd.unchanged: This shortcut is already saved — press a new one
whatsNew.round13.forms: Every form marks its required fields with a red *. The Save button is no longer greyed out: press it and each empty or wrong field says what to fix, with the cursor placed in the first one.
workflow.journal.empty: Workflows have not done anything yet
workflow.journal.emptyHint: Workflow questions, transactions waiting for your yes and the run history show up here. Try a lesson or a ready-made template on the Workflows tab.
workflow.vars.sheetHint: Values the workflows read. Open from any Workflows tab.
workflow.dropped.off: The workflow was switched off while the run slept: it did not go on.
workflow.dropped.node_removed: The wait node was removed from the workflow: the run did not go on.
workflow.dropped.rate_limit: More than 60 runs this hour: this one was skipped.
workflow.dropped.skipped: Skipped: you pressed «Skip», or the run was too long ago.
workflow.trace.empty: No steps: the trigger leads nowhere.
workflow.name: Workflow name
workflow.emulateNeedsNodes: Add nodes first — there is nothing to check yet
workflow.enableNow.title: The workflow is saved switched off. Switch it on now?
workflow.runFromDefault: From «{trigger}»; the arrow picks another trigger
workflow.missing.errors: fixing the errors: with them a workflow can only be saved switched off
workflow.canvas.empty: Add a node with the button below, a double click on the canvas or Ctrl+Space. Start with a trigger — for example, «On a schedule».
workflow.leave.title: Edits are not saved
workflow.leave.body: The saved workflow keeps working as it was. What to do with the edits?
workflow.leave.newTitle: The new workflow is not saved
workflow.leave.newHint: The new workflow is not saved yet, so it has no draft: save it or leave without it.
workflow.draft.found: There is a draft from {when}: edits kept aside without saving.
workflow.draft.saved: Draft kept: the workflow runs by its saved version
workflow.switchedOn: Workflow on: it watches from now on
workflow.deleted: Workflow deleted; the operations it made stay
workflow.exported: The workflow is copied as text: paste it into «Import» elsewhere
workflow.imported: Workflow added switched off: check it with an emulation
workflow.run.dry.failed: Emulation: an error; for real nothing would be kept
workflow.run.dry.waiting: Emulation: the run would sleep here
workflow.run.dry.asking: Emulation: the workflow asks a question; answer it in the run panel
workflow.run.live.failed: The workflow failed; nothing was kept
workflow.run.live.waiting: The workflow waits and goes on later
workflow.run.live.asking: The workflow waits for your answer under «Queue»
workflow.runPanel.question: The workflow asks
workflow.runPanel.questionHint: In a real run the question shows under «Queue». Answer it here and the emulation goes that way.
workflow.quick.tips: ↑↓ to pick, Enter to add, Esc to close
workflow.inspector.label: Label
workflow.inspector.unwire: Remove the wire and set the value here
workflow.inspector.flowEmptyOut: Not connected — add a node here
workflow.inspector.flowEmptyIn: Nothing leads here — add a node before
workflow.inspector.runsAfter: By data — after {nodes}: no flow wire needed
workflow.inspector.fillIn: Fill in this field: the workflow cannot be switched on without it
workflow.inspector.wireHint: Set a field here or wire another node's output into it: the wired value wins.
workflow.targets.total: Total: {total}%. At 100% the rounding rest goes to the last one.
workflow.settings.title: Workflow settings
workflow.settings.hint: Select a node to set it up. Here is what applies to the whole workflow.
workflow.settings.capHint: A run that would move or spend more does not run at all.
workflow.settings.reactHint: Usually off, so workflows never fire each other in circles. A workflow never reacts to its own operations.
workflow.hotkey.quickAdd: add a node at the cursor
workflow.hotkey.toggle: switch a node off or on
workflow.list.intro: A workflow is an automation made of nodes: a trigger decides when it runs, the other nodes what to do. Money moves at once unless a «Wait for confirmation» node comes first.
workflow.list.empty: No workflows yet. Take a template above or make a new one: start with a trigger.
workflow.list.automationHint: Built by the automation form and changed there
workflow.import.title: Import a workflow
workflow.import.description: Paste a workflow's text copied with «Copy as text». It arrives switched off.
workflow.import.label: Workflow text
workflow.runs.intro: Every run step by step: what fired, which values went on, why a workflow stopped.
workflow.queue.intro: Workflows wait for you here: questions from «Wait for confirmation», prepared operations and sleeping runs.
workflow.queue.empty: Nothing waits: no questions, operations or sleeping runs.
workflow.queue.questionsIntro: A workflow stopped at a «Wait for confirmation» node. «Yes» and «No» go on along their way.
workflow.vars.intro: Values that live between runs. Shared ones are seen by every workflow: change the «savings share» here and all of them use it.
workflow.vars.emptyHint: A variable keeps a number or a text between runs: say, how much was put aside this month. Workflows read and change it with «Variable» nodes.
workflow.vars.empty: No variables yet. «Set a variable» nodes create them, or the «New» button.
workflow.vars.description: A shared variable: «Get a variable» reads it with the «shared» place.
workflow.vars.name: Name
workflow.template.salaryShare.name: 10% of the salary into savings
workflow.template.salaryShare.desc: A salary comes in, a share goes to savings. Choose where.
workflow.template.lowBalance.name: Low balance on the card
workflow.template.lowBalance.desc: The balance drops below a threshold: a notice, at most once a day.
workflow.template.weeklyBuy.name: A weekly buy
workflow.template.weeklyBuy.desc: Every Friday it asks you and after «Yes» exchanges a set sum.
workflow.template.payday.name: Salary and advance: a reminder
workflow.template.payday.desc: On the 1st it finds the advance (10th) and salary (25th) days, moves them to Friday or another working day when they fall on a weekend or a holiday, and sets a reminder to book the income. To book the operation itself, the «Salary» automation moves the date and takes a varying amount.
workflow.template.payday.advance: The advance is in: book the income
workflow.template.payday.salary: The salary is in: book the income
workflow.template.workdayPayment.name: A payment on a working day
workflow.template.workdayPayment.desc: On the 10th a payment reminder; on a weekend or holiday, the next working day.
workflow.template.workdayPayment.today: The loan payment is due today
workflow.template.budgetWatch.name: The budget is nearly spent
workflow.template.budgetWatch.desc: Every evening checks a limit and tells you when 90% or more is spent.
tour.workflows.tabs.title: Workflows
tour.workflows.tabs.body: The workflows themselves and the journal: what waits for your answer and how runs went. Variables are behind the button on the right.
tour.workflows.templates.title: Templates
tour.workflows.templates.body: Open one: in the editor you only pick the accounts and switch it on.
tour.workflows.new.title: Your own
tour.workflows.new.body: An empty canvas: start with a trigger, then Ctrl+Space offers the nodes that fit.
tour.workflows.card.title: A workflow
tour.workflows.card.body: The switch turns it on; the last run's result is under the name.
tour.workflows.vars.title: Variables
tour.workflows.vars.body: Values shared by all workflows: change them here, not in each one. The panel opens from any tab.
tour.workflows.queue.title: Queue
tour.workflows.queue.body: Operations after «Wait for confirmation» wait here for your yes.
tour.workflows.runs.title: Journal
tour.workflows.runs.body: Open a run to see every step and the values it went with.
tour.workflowEditor.addFirst.title: The first node
tour.workflowEditor.addFirst.body: Start with a trigger, for instance «On a schedule» or «New transaction». A double click on the canvas opens the node search too.
tour.workflowEditor.canvas.title: Canvas
tour.workflowEditor.canvas.body: Square ports are the flow (what runs next), round ones data; the colour is the value's type. Drag a wire from an output to an input. Hold Space and drag to move the canvas.
tour.workflowEditor.quick.title: Ctrl+Space
tour.workflowEditor.quick.body: The only way to add a node: a search at the cursor. The node is wired at once — after the selected node, into the selected wire, or to the port you dragged into empty space. Understands «10%» and «> 5000». Shift+A does the same.
tour.workflowEditor.inspector.title: Settings
tour.workflowEditor.inspector.body: The selected node's fields and its help (F1). With nothing selected: the workflow's settings and its problems.
tour.workflowEditor.flows.title: The node's flow
tour.workflowEditor.flows.body: Where the run comes from and where it goes next, port by port. Cut a wire right here, or add the next node from an empty output.
tour.workflowEditor.emulate.title: Emulation
tour.workflowEditor.emulate.body: Runs the workflow on a copy of your data: you see every step and the values on the wires, nothing is kept.
tour.workflowEditor.runFrom.title: Run from…
tour.workflowEditor.runFrom.body: The button starts from «Run by hand». The arrow next to it picks any other trigger: for example, try the schedule right now, as if its time had come.
tour.workflowEditor.active.title: Switch on
tour.workflowEditor.active.body: A workflow switched on watches its triggers from that moment. With errors it cannot be switched on.
tour.workflowEditor.save.title: Save
tour.workflowEditor.save.body: Ctrl+S. The previous version is kept in the history.
whatsNew.round15.title: Workflows ask you; the exchange counts
whatsNew.round15.confirm: «Wait for confirmation» now really pauses the run: the question shows under «Queue», and «Yes» and «No» lead their own ways. In emulation you answer right in the run panel.
whatsNew.round15.emulation: Emulation is closer to a real run: after «Wait» dates and reminders count from the moment the run would wake, and events show which workflows they would start.
whatsNew.round15.hotkeys: Editor shortcuts work on any keyboard layout and after a click on the canvas; Shift+A adds a node when Ctrl+Space is taken by the language switch.
whatsNew.round15.nodes: New nodes: dates (parts, make, shift, between, start and end of a month, shift to a working day, date as text), text (find by a pattern, number from text, split, replace, join), «Convert type» into a number, date, amount or text, «Pick a value», «Round», «Switch» and list nodes.
whatsNew.round15.loops: Loops: «Repeat N times», «Count from … to», «While» and «Break the loop».
whatsNew.round15.payday: The «Salary and advance» template: on the 1st it moves pay days off weekends to a working day and sets a reminder to book the income. Lesson: «Pay day and weekends».
whatsNew.round15.chain: Set a variable, notices and reminders need no «Next», and with no wire into «In» they run by themselves at the end of the run; a variable read after a write has the new value.
whatsNew.round15.drafts: You can leave the workflow editor without saving: keep the edits as a draft (the saved workflow keeps working) or throw them away; «Undo the edits» brings the saved version back.
whatsNew.round15.currencies: Chart tooltips show values in the base and favourite currencies; hovering an amount in any currency shows it in them at once. Wallet, portfolio and utility charts get a currency switch: the base one or a favourite.
whatsNew.round15.bybitWidget: The «Bybit sync» dashboard widget: confirm loaded operations one by one or all at once.
whatsNew.round15.bybitSettings: Exchange settings get «Import» (what to load and where: accounts, kinds of operations, categories, coins, a date), «Syncs» (the load history) and «Exchange operations». Before saving you can preview what these settings would load.
whatsNew.round15.pickers: Accounts, assets and currencies are picked with the same fields everywhere: with the «Wallet › Sub-account» path and favourite currencies first.
whatsNew.round15.adjustment: A correction opened again shows all its rows and keeps every asset; saving an operation again no longer moves it in time.
whatsNew.round15.exchange: Exchange operations get the «Exchange import» mark, are never imported twice, and when the ledger still disagrees with the exchange the live balance is set by a correction.
whatsNew.round15.settings: Settings open from the gear in the header; the sidebar item is gone.
whatsNew.round14.title: Node workflows
whatsNew.round14.workflows: A new «Workflows» section: automations made of nodes: triggers, conditions, variables, data from other nodes and actions.
whatsNew.round14.editor: An editor with Ctrl+Space node search: it offers only what fits a port or a wire and understands «10%», «> 5000».
whatsNew.round14.emulation: Emulation on a copy of your data: every step in words and the values on the wires, with no risk to real accounts.
whatsNew.round14.queue: A workflow moves money at once; a «Wait for confirmation» node sends operations to a queue for your yes.
whatsNew.round14.workday: A «Working day?» node: weekends, Russian holidays and your own transfers, so a payment never lands on a day off.
workflow.explain.wouldMake: For real it would make operations: {count}.
workflow.explain.nothing: Nothing was done: no action follows the trigger, or the conditions let none through.
workflow.explain.failed: Error: {detail}. Everything the run had done is undone.
workflow.explain.waiting: It sleeps until {detail} and goes on by itself.
workflow.explain.asking: It stopped at the question «{detail}» and waits for your «Yes» or «No».
workflow.explain.partial: Some branches failed: {detail}. Their actions were undone, the rest went through.
workflow.lesson.safe: The check runs on a copy of your data: accounts do not change. You need not save a lesson.
workflow.lesson.first.title: Your first workflow
workflow.lesson.first.goal: A workflow that shows a notice at the press of a button.
workflow.lesson.first.hint: Press Ctrl+Space and find «Run by hand», then again for «Notification». Drag from the trigger's «Next» to the notification's «In». Type the text on the right while the notification is selected.
workflow.lesson.first.check.trigger: There is a «Run by hand» trigger
workflow.lesson.first.check.wire: The flow goes from the trigger to the notice
workflow.lesson.data.title: Data along wires
workflow.lesson.data.goal: Let the notice tell today's date by itself.
workflow.lesson.data.hint: Add «Now» and «Build text» with the template «Today is {a}». The «Date» output goes into {a}, the «Text» output into the notice's «Text»: a wired value replaces the field.
workflow.lesson.data.check.into: The text goes into the notice
workflow.lesson.condition.title: A condition
workflow.lesson.condition.goal: Every day at 10:00 a notice, but only on days off.
workflow.lesson.condition.text: A day off: rest from spending
workflow.lesson.condition.hint: Ctrl+Space on the selected schedule offers «Branch». Take its «Condition» from «Working day?»: the «Working» output → «Condition», and wire the notice to the «No» way.
workflow.lesson.condition.check.branch: Its answer goes into the branch's «Condition»
workflow.lesson.condition.check.notify: One of the ways leads to the notice
workflow.lesson.condition.check.emulate: The emulation went through the branch
workflow.lesson.quick.title: Quick add
workflow.lesson.quick.goal: Put «10% of the salary» between the amount and the text, in one command.
workflow.lesson.quick.hint: Click the wire from «Value» to «Build text», press Ctrl+Space, type «10%» and Enter: the node takes its place in the wire.
workflow.lesson.quick.check.percent: There is a «Math» with «10% of A»
workflow.lesson.quick.check.onward: The result goes into the text
workflow.lesson.money.title: Money with confirmation
workflow.lesson.money.goal: A transfer between your accounts that waits for your yes.
workflow.lesson.money.hint: After the trigger put «Wait for confirmation» and wire «Create an operation» to its «Yes»: kind «transfer», an account with money, where to, an amount. The emulation stops at the question: answer «Yes» and it shows the transfer; real accounts stay as they are.
workflow.lesson.money.check.confirm: The trigger leads to «Wait for confirmation»
workflow.lesson.money.check.accounts: The operation has an account and an amount
workflow.lesson.money.check.answered: You answered «Yes» in the emulation and the transfer would be made
workflow.lesson.payday.title: Pay day and weekends
workflow.lesson.payday.goal: A reminder on pay day, and on the Friday before when the 25th is a day off.
workflow.lesson.payday.hint: Add «Make a date» (day 25), wire its output to «Shift to a working day» (back), and its date into the «Date» input of a «Create a reminder» that follows the trigger. The emulation shows the day the reminder lands on.
workflow.lesson.payday.check.shift: Its date goes into «Shift to a working day»
workflow.lesson.payday.check.remind: The moved date is the reminder's «Date»
workflow.lesson.payday.check.emulate: The emulation would set the reminder
tour.workflows.lessons.title: Lessons
tour.workflows.lessons.body: Five short tasks on a copy of your data, from a first workflow to a transfer with confirmation.
tour.workflowEditor.lesson.title: Lesson
tour.workflowEditor.lesson.body: The task and its steps: they tick by themselves as you build.
whatsNew.round14.lessons: Workflow lessons: a task on the canvas, steps tick by themselves, the check is a risk-free emulation.
workflow.field.callableHint: Only workflows that start with a «Called by a workflow» trigger are listed.
workflow.note.label: Note text
workflow.note.placeholder: What this part of the workflow does…
workflow.versions.title: Versions
workflow.versions.empty: No earlier versions yet: they appear when a changed workflow is saved.
workflow.versions.restored: Version restored; the current one is kept in the history
workflow.tests.title: Tests
workflow.tests.empty: No tests yet. Emulate the saved workflow and press «Save as a test»: you will notice when an edit changes what it does.
workflow.tests.hint: Each test emulates the workflow at its moment and compares the outcome, the operations and the notices.
workflow.tests.savedOnly: The saved version is tested: save your changes first.
tour.workflowEditor.tests.title: Tests and versions
tour.workflowEditor.tests.body: A saved emulation becomes a test: after edits one button shows whether anything broke. Earlier versions can be put back.
whatsNew.round14.subflows: Helper workflows: «Call a workflow» runs a shared part inside the run and gets its answer.
whatsNew.round14.tests: Workflow tests by emulation, a version history to restore from, and notes on the canvas.
workflow.hotkey.pan: hold and drag: move the canvas along X and Y, even over nodes
whatsNew.round14.spacePan: In the workflow editor hold Space and drag: the canvas moves along X and Y from any point, even over nodes.
tour.workflowEditor.question.title: The workflow asks
tour.workflowEditor.question.body: The emulation stopped at «Wait for confirmation». Answer «Yes» or «No» and it goes that way.
tour.workflowEditor.eventRuns.title: Who responded
tour.workflowEditor.eventRuns.body: The workflows this one's events would start, and how they would end.
tour.workflowEditor.discard.title: Undo the edits
tour.workflowEditor.discard.body: Brings the saved version back. Press again to confirm.
tour.workflowEditor.draft.title: Draft
tour.workflowEditor.draft.body: Edits kept aside when you left without saving. Open them to go on, or delete them.
tour.workflowEditor.automation.title: An automation’s workflow
tour.workflowEditor.automation.body: The automation form builds it, so it is not saved here. Change it in the form or make it an ordinary workflow.
tour.workflows.questions.title: Questions from workflows
tour.workflows.questions.body: A workflow stopped and waits for you. «Yes» and «No» go on along their way.
tour.wallet.chartCurrency.title: Chart currency
tour.wallet.chartCurrency.body: Redraws the chart in the base or a favourite currency at the current rate. One choice for every chart.
tour.walletSettings.importKinds.title: What to load
tour.walletSettings.importKinds.body: Trades, transfers and Earn income switch on one by one, each with its own category.
tour.walletSettings.importPreview.title: Look first
tour.walletSettings.importPreview.body: Asks the exchange and shows what these settings would bring, before saving.
tour.walletSettings.syncHistory.title: Sync history
tour.walletSettings.syncHistory.body: Every load from the exchange: how much came, what was new, and why it failed if it did.
tour.walletSettings.imported.title: Exchange operations
tour.walletSettings.imported.body: On top what waits for confirmation, below what was already loaded.

whatsNew.interface.title: Interface: clearer and more consistent
whatsNew.interface.toasts: Every action is confirmed by a notice in the corner: what was saved, created or deleted, and on failure why and how to fix it.
whatsNew.interface.undo: Archived a wallet or a contact by mistake? Press Undo right in the notice.
settings.favoriteRejected: {code} was not saved: no such code
whatsNew.interface.loading: While data loads you see a placeholder, not «Nothing here»; if loading fails — the reason and a Retry button.
whatsNew.interface.portfolio: The Portfolio report now fully follows the chosen period and wallets: value, shares and allocation with amounts.
whatsNew.interface.automations: Automations are created right in Planning — the dialog asks for the wallet. «Add salary» opens a ready preset.
whatsNew.interface.widgets: A dashboard widget's title leads to its full screen, the «⋯» menu matches the right-click one, and a removed widget can be brought back.
whatsNew.interface.numbers: Amounts, quantities and percentages read the same on every screen; the positions table sorts by any column.
whatsNew.interface.menu: The sidebar is grouped into «Money», «Plans and analysis» and «Tools»; application settings and lock are at its bottom.
whatsNew.interface.walletSettings: Wallet settings are a few groups instead of a long row of tabs: everything about the exchange is under «Exchange & import», deposit and programme terms under «General».
whatsNew.interface.tables: Report, rate and import tables look alike, and rate columns sort.
whatsNew.interface.moved: «Losses and chains» now live in Analytics → Losses, exchange rates in Settings → Money, and «Directory» became «Contacts». Old links lead to the new places.
ui.copyFailed: Couldn't copy — select the text and copy it by hand
contacts.pickOneHint: Add your first contact on the left — whoever you send money to, lend to or borrow from.
palette.title: Go to
whatsNew.interface.palette: Ctrl+K (or «Go to…» at the top) opens quick navigation: any screen, wallet or action by a few letters.
whatsNew.interface.dates: Dates and months are picked in a calendar in the app's language, with «Today» and «Clear» — the same on every system.
whatsNew.interface.filters: The filter bar is shorter: wallet, kind and search stay in view, the rest sits under «More filters» with a count of what is set.
whatsNew.interface.pickers: Asset, currency and account search works from the keyboard: arrows move, Enter picks, Esc closes.
whatsNew.interface.header: The «Prices as of …» badge left the header: hover the total to see the rate date.
whatsNew.workflows2.title: Workflows: simpler to build, clearer wires
whatsNew.workflows2.quickAddOnly: Nodes are added one way — Ctrl+Space (or Shift+A) at the cursor. The node list on the left and the «Node» button are gone: the canvas is wider.
whatsNew.workflows2.flowsInInspector: The node panel has a «Flow» section: where the run comes from and goes, and a button to cut a wire. Long names no longer spill past the panel.
whatsNew.workflows2.dataOrder: Data sets the order: a node that takes an operation's result runs after it by itself — no flow wire needed. If the operation did not run (another branch), neither does it. Repeating flow wires are dashed and go with one click; older workflows run as before.
whatsNew.workflows2.branches: Branches are independent: when one breaks, only it is undone and the others run — the journal says «Partly». Skipped runs (switched off while waiting, the hourly limit) show in the journal with the reason too.
whatsNew.workflows2.errorPorts: Every action has an «Error» way with the reason: a failed notice, reminder or variable can be caught and handled without undoing the whole run.
whatsNew.workflows2.runFrom: «Run» and «Emulate» no longer start the schedule silently: by default they start from «Run by hand», and the arrow next to them picks any trigger of the workflow.
whatsNew.workflows2.queueNode: New «Queue» node: when a trigger fires several times in one check (several operations, missed schedule moments), it is one run, and «Queue» hands the firings on one by one. «In turn»: a failure undoes everything; «Independently»: only the failed firing is undone. No need to copy the chain of nodes.
whatsNew.workflows2.meterFormula: Utilities: a meter can have its own formula instead of «used × tariff», like (current - previous) * 3.5 * 10, tiers with min/max, a fixed fee as a term. Two- and three-rate meters: name the zones («day, night») and enter a reading for each.
whatsNew.workflows2.search: Quick jump is now a search field in the header: results drop down right under it, no separate window. Wallets look like in «To» — with the parent, asset and balance.
whatsNew.workflows2.utilityReminders: The utilities tab of a property wallet has a «Remind» button: set the pay day and get reminders to pay and to send the meter readings.
whatsNew.workflows2.time24: Time is now 24-hour everywhere, with no AM/PM: in fields and lists, in any language and on any system.
whatsNew.workflows2.selects: Drop-down lists (month and year in the calendar, kind, period, category…) look the same on every system and work from the keyboard: arrows, Enter and first letters.
auth.importHint: The file is copied into the app's storage; the original stays as it is. To send changes back to the file, turn on the copy in the vault settings.
auth.importFile: Open a file from the device…
auth.vaultNameHint: The vault is created in the app's storage. A copy in Downloads or a cloud folder can be turned on later in the vault settings.
errors.SYNC_CONFLICT: The vault and its file copy changed independently
vaultLink.title: Copy in an external file
vaultLink.hint: After every save the vault is copied to the file you choose: Downloads, a cloud folder or Syncthing. If the copy is changed on another device, those changes are taken in at the next unlock.
vaultLink.pickExistingHint: The chosen file's contents are replaced with this vault
vaultLink.unlinked: Copy turned off; the file stays where it is
vaultLink.unlinkFailed: Could not turn off the copy
vaultLink.copyFailed: The vault copy was not written
vaultLink.conflictTitle: The vault and its copy both changed
vaultLink.conflictBody: Since the last unlock both the vault on this device and its file copy changed. “Keep this vault” overwrites the copy. “Take the copy” replaces this vault and keeps the current one next to it as .bak.
vaultLink.keepRemote: Take the copy from the file
whatsNew.vaultFiles.title: Vaults on Android and a copy in a file
whatsNew.vaultFiles.androidOpen: On Android a vault opens from any file: “Open a file from the device” copies it into the app's storage. A new vault is created by name, without a path.
whatsNew.vaultFiles.externalCopy: Settings → Vault → “Copy in an external file”: after every save the vault is copied to the chosen file, and changes made to the copy on another device are taken in at unlock.
whatsNew.vaultFiles.names: Recent vaults show the right file name for Windows paths too.
auth.createVaultHintApp: An encrypted vault is created in the app's storage and opened right away.
sync.title: Device sync
sync.description: Devices on the same network with this vault open find each other and exchange changes directly, encrypted, with no cloud.
sync.enabledHint: While the vault is open, only devices with the same vault can see this one on the local network.
sync.deviceNameHint: Other devices see it while pairing.
sync.confirmFirstHint: The first changes of each session are listed and wait for you; the rest arrive by themselves.
sync.preferMain: Make this device the main one
sync.preferMainHint: The main device runs automations, workflows, exchange imports and reminders for everyone.
sync.key.hardware: The device key is kept in the system's secure hardware storage.
sync.key.system: The device key is kept in the system password storage.
sync.key.memory: No system password storage: after a restart the devices have to pair again.
sync.backup.hint: A copy of the vault is saved before the first sync of each session.
sync.backup.restored: Vault restored; the change will reach the other devices
sync.devices.title: Trusted devices
sync.devices.description: The vault syncs with them by itself while it is open on both.
sync.devices.emptyHint: Open this vault on another device on the same network and turn sync on there — you will be offered to pair.
sync.devices.emptyOff: Turn sync on above, then open this vault on another device on the same network.
sync.devices.forgetHint: A forgotten device is refused everywhere. If it was lost, change the vault password: the copy on it cannot be revoked.
sync.history.title: Sync history
sync.history.description: What came from other devices in the last week. Undo puts back the records nobody changed since.
sync.history.emptyHint: Every batch of changes from another device shows up here, ready to undo.
sync.history.undoHint: An undo syncs too: the records come back on the other device as well.
sync.offer.title: “{name}” with this vault is nearby
sync.offer.body: Pair the devices so changes move between them by themselves. Both screens will show the same code.
sync.pairing.title: Pairing code
sync.pairing.hint: The codes must match. If they differ, someone on the network is in between: press “Doesn't match”.
sync.pairing.waiting: Waiting for the other device to confirm
sync.plan.title: Changes from “{name}”
sync.plan.reason.first: “Ask before syncing” is on: these are the first changes of the session.
sync.plan.reason.paired: The first sync with this device.
sync.plan.reason.unreliable: This device's time jumped: every change from it waits for you.
sync.plan.nothing: No values change — only sync marks.
sync.plan.overwrittenHint: This field was changed on both devices; the later edit stays.
sync.plan.safety: A copy of the vault is saved before applying, and the whole batch can be undone in the sync history.
sync.saveFailed: Could not save the sync settings
sync.clock.skew: The clock on “{name}” is {minutes} min off from this one — check the time
sync.clock.jumped: The time on “{name}” jumps: until the session ends its changes wait for you
sync.undo.skipped: Left as they are, changed later: {names}
sync.passwordHint: Other devices keep the old password: change it there too if you want the same one.
transfer.receive.title: Receive a vault
transfer.receive.description: Another device of yours hands its vault over here on the local network.
transfer.receive.howTo: On the device with the vault open Settings → Sync → Vault transfer → «Send» and pick this name.
transfer.receive.request: «{name}» wants to hand you its vault
transfer.receive.requestHint: Accept only if it is your device. A code to confirm shows up next.
transfer.receive.doneHint: It has the same password as on the other device. Sync with it is on.
transfer.receive.cardHint: Have the vault on another device already? Receive it over Wi-Fi, no files or cloud.
transfer.send.title: Send to a new device
transfer.send.description: A copy of this vault goes to a device nearby that waits to receive.
transfer.send.searchingHint: On the new device open «Receive from another device»: it shows up here by its name.
transfer.send.passwordHint: Again, even with the vault open: only someone who knows the password can hand it over.
transfer.send.warning: Send only to your own device: whoever gets the file has a copy of the vault and can try passwords on it.
transfer.send.codeWrong: The code did not match, tries left: {count}
transfer.send.doneHint: The transfer is in the sync history, and the linked devices were notified.
transfer.section.title: Vault transfer
transfer.section.description: Move the whole vault to a new device on the local network: by the device name, the password and a one-time code.
transfer.section.sendHint: The new device must be waiting to receive on this network.
transfer.section.receiveHint: Add one more vault here from another device of yours.
sync.network.title: Network
sync.network.lonelyHint: Check that the devices are on the same Wi-Fi network, the app is open with this vault and sync is on on both, and the firewall lets port 53318/tcp through.
sync.firewall.maybe: A firewall may be in the way
sync.firewall.autoHint: Another device could not connect here, so this device calls it instead. Open port 53318/tcp for the local network only, and connections will work both ways.
sync.firewall.manualHint: The app runs in a sandbox and cannot change the firewall itself. Run the command in a terminal (the first for ufw, the second for firewalld): port 53318/tcp opens for the local network only.
sync.firewall.opened: Port 53318 is open for the local network
sync.backgroundLock.label: Lock in the background
sync.backgroundLock.hint: A minimized app keeps syncing (a notification shows it). If no sync happens for this long, the vault locks.
errors.SYNC_CHANNEL: The connection broke or the data was damaged
errors.SYNC_OTHER_VAULT: That device has another vault open
errors.SYNC_VERSION_MISMATCH: The app versions do not match — update the app on both devices
errors.SYNC_CLOCK_SKEW: The devices' clocks differ by more than a day — fix the time
errors.SYNC_REVOKED: The device was forgotten — pair it again
errors.SYNC_FIREWALL: The firewall was not changed: cancelled, or no supported firewall found
errors.SYNC_TRANSFER_DECLINED: The other device declined the transfer
errors.SYNC_TRANSFER_EXPIRED: Five minutes are up: the device is no longer visible
errors.SYNC_NOT_A_VAULT: What arrived is not a vault file
tour.dashboard.sync.title: Sync
tour.dashboard.sync.body: How many devices are in sync right now. Click to open the devices and the history.
whatsNew.lanSync.title: Device sync over Wi-Fi
whatsNew.lanSync.lan: Settings → Sync: two devices on the same network with this vault exchange changes directly and encrypted.
whatsNew.lanSync.pairing: The first time, both screens show the same six-digit code; after that sync runs by itself.
whatsNew.lanSync.merge: Edits of different fields of one record both stay; when one field was changed on two devices, the later edit stays and the list shows it.
whatsNew.lanSync.undo: Every batch of changes can be undone in the history, and a copy of the vault is saved before syncing.
whatsNew.lanSync.deviceSettings: Minimizing to the tray and the price refresh interval are now each device's own.
whatsNew.lanSyncReach.title: Sync finds devices more reliably
whatsNew.lanSyncReach.callback: When a firewall on one device drops incoming connections, the other device connects to it instead.
whatsNew.lanSyncReach.firewall: Settings → Sync shows the port, the address and how many devices are nearby, and «Open the port» opens it for the local network only.
whatsNew.lanSyncReach.background: On Android, sync goes on while the app is minimized. A notification says so, and the vault locks after the chosen time without a sync.
whatsNew.vaultTransfer.title: Hand the vault to a new device
whatsNew.vaultTransfer.how: Settings → Sync → Vault transfer: the new device shows up nearby by a name like «Swift Mango»; pick it and type the password.
whatsNew.vaultTransfer.code: The new device accepts the request first, then shows a code; nothing leaves without it, and it cannot be guessed by listening in.
whatsNew.vaultTransfer.trace: Every transfer is in the sync history and shows up as a notice on all linked devices.
whatsNew.vaultTransfer.names: Devices got names the LocalSend way; change yours in the sync settings.
whatsNew.cryptoFavorites.everywhere: Favourites come first with a star in every currency and asset list, in the rates and in the tooltip of amounts; the arrows in the settings change their order.
whatsNew.screens.title: Easier on every screen
whatsNew.screens.available: Under the amount of a payment, transfer, exchange or trade you see what the account holds, and «All» puts the whole balance in. A spot trade sells the quote currency by default.
whatsNew.screens.walletCards: A wallet card opens as a whole, names its assets and last transaction; archive and delete are in the «…» menu.
whatsNew.screens.walletStats: Wallet figures follow its kind: a bank shows the month in and out, a loan its rate and payment, an exchange the unrealized result and fees.
whatsNew.screens.journalDays: Transactions are grouped by day with the day total; row buttons show on hover.
whatsNew.screens.calendar: The calendar marks today, the chosen day opens beside it, and «Show in the list» leads to the journal.
whatsNew.screens.reminders: Reminders are split into «Overdue», «Today» and «Later», each with a visible «Snooze» button.
whatsNew.screens.requiredFields: Required node fields are marked «*»: a workflow with one empty cannot be switched on. Such workflows that were on are now off, and a notice says so.
whatsNew.positions.title: Positions and the asset sheet
whatsNew.positions.prices: Wallet positions show the price and value in your favourite currencies, the result with a percentage, the 24 h change and when the prices were taken.
whatsNew.positions.sheet: Click a position: a sheet opens with the price and its source, a chart, the alerts on this asset and links to its transactions.
whatsNew.positions.elsewhere: The asset sheet shows which other wallets hold the same ticker, on which network and how much in total; a stablecoin with no price is marked «pegged at $1».
whatsNew.positions.txCard: The transaction card also opens from a contact, an exchange import and conversion chains; it shows the coin price then and now, «Duplicate» and «Copy the ID».
whatsNew.positions.walletBlocks: Coin wallets and exchanges show a ring by asset and the losses on their conversions; the dashboard allocation got a chart.
whatsNew.positions.pairs: A trading pair in the terminal, a futures trade and a sub-account binding is picked by searching the coin.
tour.wallet.positions.title: Positions
tour.wallet.positions.body: Hover a price to see where it is from and when it was taken. Click a row for the chart, alerts and history of the asset.
whatsNew.cryptoFavorites.title: Crypto in favourites
whatsNew.cryptoFavorites.codes: Any ticker can be a favourite, USDT, DOGE and 1INCH included, and your order is kept. A code that does not exist is no longer «saved» silently — you are told why.
whatsNew.cryptoFavorites.rates: A favourite coin shows in the rates, in the tooltip of any amount and in the chart currency switch: its rate comes from the latest price.
whatsNew.cryptoFavorites.catalog: The currency list no longer loses its crypto after a network failure: the main coins are always there, and the list has a «Load again» button.
whatsNew.analyticsFixes.title: Analytics: more precise
whatsNew.analyticsFixes.realTerms: «In today’s money» is one switch in the filter; it works in «Income and spending» and «What I have» only.
whatsNew.analyticsFixes.drillDown: A bar of profit, fees or losses opens that month’s transactions, across all the wallets picked.
whatsNew.analyticsFixes.empty: Empty profit and net worth reports say there is no data instead of drawing empty axes; «Year» follows the wallets picked.
whatsNew.analyticsFixes.month: The overview month is picked on its own and no longer moves the other sections’ period.
whatsNew.polish.title: Small improvements
whatsNew.polish.checklist: First steps on the dashboard: progress, «Not needed» on each step, and «Do it» for the first transaction opens the form.
whatsNew.polish.header: The header shows net worth, as the dashboard does; widgets are added with the «Widgets» button above the grid.
whatsNew.polish.planning: Planning lists work the same way, and an empty list has one button — in its hint.
whatsNew.polish.workflows: A new workflow offers to switch on after saving; a node is added with a double or right click on the canvas.
whatsNew.polish.wallet: An empty wallet offers to record the first transaction right away; moves between your own wallets are not coloured as income or spending.
whatsNew.polish.firstRun: A new install no longer shows the whole «What’s new» history.
whatsNew.reportsRework.title: Clearer analytics, simpler sections
whatsNew.reportsRework.overview: Analytics opens with an overview: four cards with the month's main figures and a takeaway in words.
whatsNew.reportsRework.sections: Nine reports are now three sections: Income and spending, What I have, and Investments. Old links still work.
whatsNew.reportsRework.insights: Every report says what its numbers mean, and column names explain themselves on hover.
whatsNew.reportsRework.filter: The filter has quick periods and picks several wallets at once.
whatsNew.reportsRework.phone: On a narrow screen tables keep the main columns; the rest opens from a row.
whatsNew.reportsRework.graph: The Graph tab in Transactions is gone: it was hard to use. Money moving through chains is in Analytics → Investments.
whatsNew.reportsRework.journal: Workflows have two tabs: Workflows and Journal, with the queue and runs together. Variables open as a panel.
whatsNew.reportsRework.contacts: Contacts moved into Transactions, as the Contacts and debts tab. A contact's card opens all transactions with them.
whatsNew.reportsRework.nav: A shorter menu: Money has wallets, transactions and analytics; Plans has planning and workflows.
workflow.canvas.emptyTouch: Start with a trigger, for example «On a schedule»: it decides when the workflow runs.
tour.dashboard.bottomNav.title: Sections under your thumb
tour.dashboard.bottomNav.body: Home, wallets, a new transaction («+») and the transaction list. «More» opens the menu with the other sections and the settings.
tour.workflowEditor.addTouch.title: Add a node
tour.workflowEditor.addTouch.body: The «+» opens the node search; the new node lands in the middle of the canvas. Tap a node to open its settings below.
whatsNew.stable.title: A steadier interface
whatsNew.stable.rowMenu: Each transaction in a list has one «⋯» button with its actions (open, edit, duplicate, delete, explorer link): amounts line up and no longer shift on hover.
whatsNew.stable.settingsSections: A settings tab lists its sections above the content: the sidebar no longer moves under the pointer.
whatsNew.stable.toasts: «Undo» in a notification works while a dialog is open, and the dialog stays open.
whatsNew.stable.start: The dark theme opens dark, without a white flash; rate tooltips wait a moment instead of popping at every mouse move.
vaultSave.failed: Changes are not saved to the file
whatsNew.stable.saving: Changes are written to the file in one go half a second after the last edit, so the interface no longer waits for the disk; quitting, locking and hiding the window write at once.
whatsNew.stable.prices: The «Price refresh interval» in the device settings now works: prices and rates refresh by themselves while the window is open.
whatsNew.stable.settingsWindow: The settings window sizes itself to the screen: nothing hits the edges on a laptop, and it does not sprawl on a large monitor. Switches and hints line up.
whatsNew.stable.editCommands: The workflow editor has Undo, Redo, Duplicate, Copy and Paste buttons (on a phone in the «⋯» menu). The exchange chart has a «Price alert» button.
whatsNew.stable.touch: On a phone, buttons catch a finger over the whole area it needs, the widget «⋯» menu is always visible, stacked widgets move with «Move up»/«Move down», and a report term explains itself on a tap.
whatsNew.stable.property: A property with no operations shows its «Utilities» tab right away, so a bill can be paid before the first operation.
tour.workflowEditor.editCommands.title: Editing
tour.workflowEditor.editCommands.body: Undo, redo, duplicate, copy and paste the selected nodes: the same as Ctrl+Z, Ctrl+D, Ctrl+C and Ctrl+V.
calendar.perDayLeftLabel: May spend per day from here
tour.transactionsCalendar.balance.title: The month balance
tour.transactionsCalendar.balance.body: The month budget minus everything spent: what is left and what each following day may spend. A day cell shows the rest after it; marks show that day’s notifications, price alerts and payments.
whatsNew.stable.calendar: The operations calendar is one column and keeps a running balance: the month budget left after each day (mandatory payments do not reduce it), a forecast for the days ahead, what each following day may spend, plus notifications, price alerts and payments on their days.
calendar.forecastHint: Forecast: what is left by the end of this day if spending keeps to the plan
tour.dashboard.sidebarToggle.title: Fold the menu
tour.dashboard.sidebarToggle.body: The button by the logo folds the menu into a strip of icons; folded, the logo unfolds it again. Same as Ctrl+B.
whatsNew.stable.saldoReport: Analytics has a new «Balance» tab: what is left of the month on each day, charts of the balance and of spending against the day limit, and every date leads to its transactions.
whatsNew.stable.sidebarToggle: The menu folds with the button by the logo; folded, the logo itself unfolds it (on hover it turns into the button).
whatsNew.phone.title: A layout for phones
whatsNew.phone.bottomNav: The main sections and a new-transaction button sit at the bottom; «More» opens the rest.
whatsNew.phone.sheets: Dialogs and filters slide up from the bottom and close with a swipe; list rows have a «⋯» button with their actions.
whatsNew.phone.back: The system Back button closes an open window first, then returns to the previous screen; on Home a double press minimises the app.
whatsNew.phone.editor: The workflow editor works by touch: «+» on the canvas, the node panel below, ports joined with a tap.
whatsNew.phone.insets: The screen keeps clear of the status bar, the camera cut-out and the gesture bar; the status bar icons follow the theme.
entity.missing.title: Not found
entity.missing.description: This record was deleted or has not synced yet.
whatsNew.links.title: Everything is linked
whatsNew.links.card: An operation, category, goal, budget and other records open as a card over the screen: what they are linked to and what to do next.
whatsNew.links.chips: Wallet, category and contact names in an operation card are links; right-click opens the actions menu.
whatsNew.links.notices: Reminder and budget notices open the record itself, not the whole list.
whatsNew.links.address: The Back button returns to the previous card, and the screen address remembers the open one.
